title: Braces
description: Braces for children and adults in Kohalpur to straighten crooked teeth, close gaps and correct the bite.
body:
Straight teeth are not only about looks. Teeth that are crowded or overlapping are harder to clean, and a bite that doesn't meet properly can wear teeth unevenly or strain the jaw. Braces move teeth slowly and safely into a better position.

Who can benefit from braces?

  • Crowded or crooked teeth
  • Gaps between teeth
  • Upper teeth that stick out (overjet) or a deep bite
  • An underbite, crossbite or open bite
  • Teeth that have drifted after a tooth was lost

There is no upper age limit. Many adults choose braces too, as long as the teeth and gums are healthy.

How braces move teeth

Small brackets are bonded to the teeth and connected by a thin archwire. The wire applies gentle, steady pressure, and the bone around each tooth slowly remodels to let it move. We adjust the wire at regular visits to guide the teeth step by step.

Types of braces

  • Metal braces: strong, reliable and the most economical option
  • Ceramic braces: tooth-coloured brackets that are less noticeable
  • Clear aligners: removable transparent trays, suitable for many cases

Starting treatment

We begin with an examination, photographs and X-rays to plan exactly how the teeth need to move. You will know the expected treatment time and the type of brace that suits you before anything starts.

How long does it take?

Most treatments last between one and two years, depending on how much correction is needed. After the braces come off, a retainer keeps the teeth in their new position.

Cost of braces

title: Clear Aligners
description: Clear aligners in Kohalpur: nearly invisible, removable trays that straighten teeth without wires or brackets.
body:
Clear Aligners

Clear aligners are a series of thin, transparent trays made to fit your teeth exactly. Each set is shaped slightly differently from the last, so as you move through the series, your teeth shift gradually into line.

Why people choose aligners

  • Almost invisible when worn, which suits working adults and students
  • Removable, so you can eat normally and brush and floss as usual
  • Smooth plastic with no wires or brackets to rub the cheeks
  • Fewer emergency visits, because there is nothing to break off

Are they right for me?

Aligners work very well for mild to moderate crowding, spacing and many bite problems. Some complex cases still move more predictably with fixed braces. After an examination we will tell you honestly which option suits you.

How the treatment works

We take a detailed record of your teeth and plan the movement of each tooth. Your aligners are then made from that plan. You change to a new set every one to two weeks and visit us periodically so we can check progress.

Wearing your aligners

For results, aligners need to be worn for about 20 to 22 hours a day. Take them out to eat or drink anything other than water, then brush before putting them back in. Each new set may feel tight for a day or two, which is a sign it is working.

How long does treatment take?

Simple cases may finish in a few months; others take a year or more. A retainer is used afterwards to hold the result.

Cost of clear aligners

title: Crowns & Bridges
description: Dental crowns to protect weak teeth and bridges to replace missing teeth, at Freshdent Clinic, Kohalpur.
body:
Dental Crowns (Caps)

A crown is a cover that fits over the whole visible part of a tooth. It restores the tooth's shape and strength when a filling alone would not be enough.

When is a crown needed?

  • After root canal treatment, to protect the tooth
  • For a tooth that is cracked, badly broken or heavily filled
  • To improve the look of a misshapen or discoloured tooth
  • On top of a dental implant

Crowns can be made in metal-ceramic, full ceramic or zirconia. We will help you choose based on the position of the tooth, strength and appearance.

Dental Bridge

A bridge replaces one or more missing teeth by joining an artificial tooth to crowns on the teeth either side of the gap. It is fixed in place and fills the space, which also stops the neighbouring teeth from drifting.

How crowns and bridges are made

At the first visit the supporting teeth are shaped, a measurement is taken and a temporary cover is fitted. The final crown or bridge is made to match your tooth colour, then checked and cemented at the next visit.

Looking after them

Brush twice a day, clean under the bridge with floss threaders or interdental brushes, and keep up regular check-ups. With good care, crowns and bridges can last for many years.

title: Dental Implants
description: Dental implants in Kohalpur: a fixed, natural-looking replacement for missing teeth.
body:
Dental Implant

A dental implant replaces the root of a missing tooth. It is a small post, usually made of titanium, that is placed in the jawbone. Once it has bonded with the bone, a crown is attached on top, giving you a tooth that looks and works much like the original.

Why choose an implant?

  • Fixed in place, with nothing to remove at night
  • Neighbouring teeth do not need to be trimmed, as they would for a bridge
  • Helps preserve the jawbone where the tooth was lost
  • Comfortable to chew with, and cleaned like a natural tooth

The treatment, step by step

We first examine the area and take X-rays to check the amount of bone. The implant is placed under local anaesthetic in a minor procedure. Over the next few months it fuses with the bone (osseointegration). Finally, a custom crown is made to match your other teeth and fixed onto the implant.

Is it painful?

The procedure is done under local anaesthesia, so you should not feel pain during it. Mild soreness for a few days afterwards is common and is easily managed with the medicine we prescribe.

Am I suitable for an implant?

Most healthy adults are. Conditions such as uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking or very thin bone can affect healing, so we assess your general health and bone before recommending treatment.

Cost of a dental implant

title: Dentures
description: Complete and partial dentures in Kohalpur to restore your smile, chewing and speech.
body:
Dentures

When many or all teeth are missing, eating and speaking become difficult and the face can look sunken. A denture is a removable replacement that restores the teeth and supports the lips and cheeks.

Types of dentures

  • Complete dentures replace all the teeth in the upper or lower jaw
  • Partial dentures fill gaps when some natural teeth remain
  • Implant-supported dentures clip onto implants for extra stability

Benefits

  • Chew a wider range of food more comfortably
  • Speak more clearly
  • Restore the fullness of the face and the look of your smile
  • An affordable way to replace many teeth

Getting used to dentures

New dentures can feel strange at first. Start with soft food cut into small pieces and chew on both sides. Speaking may feel different for a few days. Small sore spots are common and we can adjust the fit at a review visit.

Caring for dentures

Take them out and clean them daily, rinse after meals, and keep them in water overnight. Have them checked regularly, because the gums and bone change shape over time.

title: Digital Smile Design
description: Digital Smile Design in Kohalpur: preview your new smile before treatment begins.
body:
Digital Smile Designing

Digital Smile Design (DSD) lets you see a preview of your new smile before any treatment starts. Using photos and videos of your face and teeth, we design the ideal tooth shape, length and colour to suit your features.

How it works

  • We take photographs and short videos of you smiling and talking
  • The design is planned on screen, in proportion to your lips and face
  • You review the preview with us and we adjust it together
  • The approved design guides your veneers, crowns, aligners or whitening

Benefits of the DSD

  • You can see the expected result in advance
  • A smile that is planned to suit your face, not just your teeth
  • Clearer communication between you and your dentist
  • More predictable cosmetic treatment

Curious how your smile could look? Ask about a smile design consultation at Freshdent Clinic.

title: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
description: Full mouth rehabilitation in Kohalpur: rebuilding worn, broken or missing teeth for a healthy, comfortable bite.
body:
Full Mouth Rehabilitation

Full mouth rehabilitation is a planned treatment that rebuilds or replaces all the teeth in both jaws. It brings together several treatments, such as crowns, bridges, implants and root canals, to restore comfortable chewing, a stable bite and a natural-looking smile.

Who may need it?

  • People whose teeth are severely worn down, for example from grinding
  • Several broken, decayed or missing teeth
  • A bite that has collapsed or causes jaw pain
  • Previous dental work that has failed in many places

How it is planned

We start with a complete examination, X-rays, photographs and models of your teeth. A step-by-step plan is made and explained to you, often with a trial set-up so you can see the planned result. Treatment is then done in stages over several visits.

title: Gum Treatment
description: Treatment for bleeding, swollen or receding gums in Kohalpur. Deep cleaning and gum care to protect your teeth.
body:
Gum Treatment

Healthy gums are firm, pink and do not bleed when you brush. When plaque and tartar build up along the gum line, the gums become inflamed. This early stage is called gingivitis, and it can be reversed. Left alone, it can progress to periodontitis, where the bone holding the teeth is slowly lost.

Warning signs

  • Gums that bleed while brushing or flossing
  • Red, puffy or tender gums
  • Bad breath that keeps coming back
  • Gums pulling away from the teeth, or teeth that feel loose

How we treat gum disease

Treatment starts with a thorough cleaning to remove tartar above and below the gum line. Where the gums have formed deeper pockets, we carry out deep cleaning (root planing) to smooth the root surfaces so the gum can reattach. We then show you the brushing and cleaning routine that keeps the problem from returning.

If your gums bleed, don't ignore it. Book a gum check-up at Freshdent Clinic, Kohalpur.

title: Kids Dentistry
description: Friendly dental care for children in Kohalpur: check-ups, fillings, fluoride and sealants.
body:
Pediatric Dentistry

Good dental habits start early. Milk teeth help children chew, speak clearly and hold space for the adult teeth, so they deserve the same care as permanent teeth. We aim to make every visit calm and friendly, so children grow up without a fear of the dentist.

Treatments we offer for children

  • Check-ups and gentle cleaning
  • Fluoride application to strengthen enamel
  • Pit and fissure sealants to protect back teeth from decay
  • Tooth-coloured fillings and treatment of decayed milk teeth
  • Advice on thumb-sucking, teething and early orthodontic problems

When should the first visit be?

We recommend a first check-up by the child's first birthday, or when the first tooth appears. After that, a visit every six months helps catch problems early.

Tips for parents

  • Clean your child's teeth twice a day with a smear of fluoride toothpaste
  • Avoid putting a child to sleep with a bottle of milk or juice
  • Limit sweets and sugary drinks between meals
  • Help with brushing until about age 7 or 8

title: Minor Oral Surgery & Wisdom Teeth
description: Safe wisdom tooth removal and minor oral surgery in Kohalpur under local anaesthesia. Relief from pain, swelling and crowding.
body:
Oral Surgery

Wisdom teeth are the third molars at the very back of the mouth. They usually come through between the ages of 17 and 25, long after the other teeth have settled, so there is often not enough room for them.

Why wisdom teeth cause trouble

When a wisdom tooth is blocked by bone or the tooth in front, it is called impacted. It may come through only partly, leaving a flap of gum where food collects. This can lead to:

  • Pain and swelling at the back of the jaw
  • Gum infection (pericoronitis) and a bad taste
  • Decay in the wisdom tooth or the molar beside it
  • Difficulty opening the mouth fully

Does it always need to be removed?

No. A wisdom tooth that is upright, fully through and easy to clean can stay. We take an X-ray to see its position and roots, and only recommend removal when it is causing problems or is likely to.

How the procedure is done

The area is fully numbed. A tooth that has erupted can usually be removed simply. An impacted tooth may need a small opening in the gum, and sometimes the tooth is divided into pieces so it comes out more gently. A few stitches may be placed, and you will get clear aftercare instructions.

Recovery

Some swelling and soreness for a few days is normal. Soft food, the medicines we prescribe and gentle salt-water rinses after the first day help healing. Avoid smoking and using a straw while the area heals.

title: Root Canal Treatment
description: Gentle root canal treatment in Kohalpur to stop tooth pain, clear infection and keep your natural tooth. Book a visit at Freshdent Clinic.
body:
A deep cavity, a crack or an old filling that has leaked can let bacteria reach the soft centre of a tooth, called the pulp. Once the pulp is infected, the tooth usually aches, reacts to hot and cold, or makes the gum swell. Root canal treatment removes that infection so the tooth can be kept instead of pulled out.

Signs you may need a root canal

  • Throbbing pain that wakes you up or lasts a long time
  • Sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers after the food is gone
  • Pain when biting or chewing on one side
  • A swelling or small pimple on the gum near a tooth
  • A tooth that has turned darker than its neighbours

What happens during treatment

The area is first numbed with local anaesthetic. The dentist makes a small opening in the top of the tooth, cleans out the infected pulp, and shapes and disinfects each canal. The canals are then sealed so bacteria cannot return. Most patients say it feels much like having a filling.

Why a crown is recommended afterwards

A tooth that needed a root canal has often lost a lot of its structure, and without its pulp it becomes more brittle over time. A custom-made crown covers and protects it, so it can keep chewing safely for many years. We take a measurement of the tooth and fit the finished crown at a later visit.

How many visits will it take?

Straightforward cases can often be finished in a single sitting. Teeth with a severe infection may need two or more visits, with medicine placed inside the tooth between appointments to settle it down.

Cost of root canal treatment

title: Teeth Cleaning (Scaling & Polishing)
description: Professional teeth cleaning (scaling and polishing) in Kohalpur for healthier gums and fresher breath.
body:
Even with careful brushing, plaque builds up in places a toothbrush can't reach. Over time it hardens into tartar (calculus), which only a dental professional can remove. A regular cleaning keeps your gums healthy and your teeth looking their best.

Scaling

Scaling removes tartar and stains from the tooth surfaces and just under the gum line, usually with an ultrasonic instrument and fine hand tools. It is generally comfortable; if your gums are sensitive, we can numb the area.

Polishing

After scaling, the teeth are polished to remove surface stains and leave them smooth. A smooth surface makes it harder for plaque to stick again.

Why regular cleaning matters

  • Prevents and treats bleeding gums
  • Freshens breath
  • Removes tea, coffee and tobacco stains
  • Lets the dentist spot cavities and other problems early

How often should I have a cleaning?

Every six months suits most people. If you have gum disease, braces or smoke, we may suggest more frequent visits.

title: Teeth Whitening
description: Professional teeth whitening in Kohalpur: a safe, dentist-supervised way to brighten your smile.
body:
Teeth Whitening

Tea, coffee, tobacco and simply getting older can all darken the colour of teeth. Professional whitening lightens these stains and gives a brighter, fresher-looking smile. It is a cosmetic treatment, and the aim is a natural, healthy shade rather than an artificial bright white.

In-clinic and home whitening

In-clinic whitening uses a professional gel applied while the gums are protected, and gives a visible change in a single visit. Home whitening uses custom-fitted trays and a milder gel worn for a set time each day over one to two weeks.

Is whitening safe for my enamel?

When carried out or supervised by a dentist, whitening is safe for the enamel. Some people notice temporary sensitivity for a day or two, which settles on its own. We check your teeth first, because cavities or gum problems should be treated before whitening.

Things to know before whitening

  • Fillings, crowns and veneers do not change colour
  • Whitening is usually postponed during pregnancy
  • Avoid strongly coloured food and drinks for 48 hours afterwards
  • Results last longer if you avoid smoking and keep up cleaning visits

title: Tooth-Coloured Fillings
description: Tooth-coloured fillings in Kohalpur to repair cavities and chipped teeth with a natural look.
body:
Cavity Filling

A cavity is a hole in a tooth caused by decay. In the early stages it may not hurt at all, which is why regular check-ups matter. Treating a cavity while it is small keeps the repair simple and protects the nerve of the tooth.

How a filling is done

The tooth is numbed if needed, the decay is removed and the area is cleaned. The space is then filled and shaped to fit your bite. Most fillings are completed in one short visit.

Types of fillings

  • Composite (tooth-coloured): matched to your tooth shade and bonded to the tooth
  • Glass ionomer: releases fluoride, often used for children's teeth and near the gum line
  • Ceramic inlays and onlays: lab-made for larger repairs on back teeth

Tooth-coloured fillings are our usual choice because they blend in with the tooth and need less drilling.

title: Veneers & Laminates
description: Porcelain and composite veneers in Kohalpur to improve the shape, colour and size of front teeth.
body:
Dental Veneers

A veneer is a very thin, tooth-coloured shell that is bonded to the front surface of a tooth. Veneers are used to give teeth a better shape, colour or size, and can transform a smile with only a small change to the natural tooth.

What veneers can correct

  • Stains that whitening cannot remove
  • Chipped, worn or slightly broken edges
  • Small gaps between front teeth
  • Teeth that are uneven in length or slightly out of line

Porcelain or composite?

Porcelain veneers are made in a dental laboratory. They resist staining and look very natural. Composite veneers are built up directly on the tooth in one visit and cost less, but may need polishing or repair over the years.

The process

We first plan the shape and shade with you. For porcelain veneers, a thin layer of enamel is gently reshaped, a measurement is taken, and temporary covers are placed while the lab makes your veneers. At the next visit they are tried in, adjusted and bonded in place.

Does it hurt?

Only a small amount of enamel is shaped, and local anaesthetic is used when needed, so the procedure is comfortable.

How long do veneers last?

With good care, porcelain veneers often last 10 years or more. Avoid biting very hard objects, wear a night guard if you grind your teeth, and keep up regular check-ups.
